story.body: You waited with empty hands while he read. The wedding's cloth was in the same room. You did not offer him a play for it.

story.body: Tilney struck two oaths and signed. You answered him on the name and on the ambassador. Heminges counted seven shillings of the company's onto the table. You left with the signature and without a part in your pocket.

title: Heard the two oaths struck and saw the fee counted

story.body: You held the book while Heminges entered the fee, and said what two struck oaths felt like.

title: Said the cut was little and felt it so much
